title: The image of a universally closed morphism is universally closed
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter spaces-morphisms.tex (Morphisms of Algebraic Spaces)
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file spaces-morphisms.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for a morphism f : X -> Y of algebraic spaces over B, if X is universally closed over B and f is surjective then Y is universally closed over B; in particular if Y is also separated and of finite type over B then Y is proper over B (source lines 8210-8217). The proof is a direct base change argument: for any B' -> B the base change f' is surjective and the base change of X -> B is closed, so for closed T in Y_{B'} the set (f')^{-1}(T) is closed and its image under the closed map X_{B'} -> B', which equals the image of T, is closed; hence the structure map of Y_{B'} is closed.
